requirements.title: Description-driven classification
requirements.description: The classifier ranks provider leaves using only registry natural-language descriptions and the query — no provider-specific routing code. Search Hub retrieves a bounded description shortlist through the shared embedding contract and retains deterministic enumeration as an explicit degraded fallback.

validation.notes: Against the composed router.routing suite, routing recall@K >= 0.85; per-provider breakdown and precision reported.
Adding a new registry row changes routing with no classifier code change.

requirements.title: Widen-on-uncertainty + override
requirements.description: When the classifier is uncertain it widens (more provider types) rather than dropping; explicit --type/--all always override the classifier; --explain returns the routing rationale.

validation.notes: An ambiguous query routes to a wider set, not an empty/narrow set.

requirements.title: Bounded provider-description retrieval
requirements.description: The router shall retrieve only a bounded provider-description shortlist through the shared embedding contract, persist descriptor vectors with model metadata, and name routing_index_unavailable when deterministic relevance-scored enumeration is used as the fallback.

validation.notes: The index returns a bounded shortlist and records omitted providers.
Persisted descriptor vectors are reused across restart and only changed descriptors are re-embedded.
Unavailable embedding falls back with the stable routing_index_unavailable reason.
